subject: Application Security: Comprehensive Vulnerability Management & SBOM Submission
messages:
From: Marta Klein <marta.klein@atlasfin.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: security@atlasfin.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: full vulnerability management package + SBOM for procurement RFP

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking our procurement questionnaire. As part of Atlas Financial's vendor risk review we need a consolidated vulnerability management package that addresses: SAST/DAST tooling and cadence, patch SLAs per severity, recent penetration test summaries and remediation evidence, and a machine-readable SBOM for the current production runtime.

Please include:
- SBOM (CycloneDX or SPDX preferred) covering runtime deps and container images
- Penetration test executive summary + remediation verification (last 12 months)
- SAST/DAST toolset and frequency, and code review process for critical findings
- Patch/mitigation SLAs for critical / high / medium / low vulnerabilities
- Where discrete evidence is stored (secure link or portal) and who will be our point of contact for follow-ups

We need to present the materials to our CTO and InfoSec on Friday 6/25. Can you confirm delivery and a short walkthrough call?

Thanks,
Marta Klein
Head of Vendor Risk, Atlas Financial
M: +1 415-555-0123

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Klein <marta.klein@atlasfin.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: full vulnerability management package + SBOM for procurement RFP

Marta —

Appreciate the clear list. Attached is a bundled package we prepared specifically for procurement reviews. Highlights below; full artifacts are attached and the SBOM is in CycloneDX v1.4 format (redwood_sbom_20270622.json).

Summary (short):
- SBOM: CycloneDX JSON, generated per build pipeline and validated against runtime images. We regenerate the SBOM for each production release; canonical copies are stored in our secure evidence Drive (link below).
- Pen test: Recent third-party test (04/2027) with executive summary attached (penetration-summary-q1-2027.pdf). Findings were Triage: Critical=1 (remediated and verified), High=3 (remediated), Medium=6 (remediated/under remediation). Remediation verification is documented in the Drive folder.
- SAST/DAST: We run SAST on all pull requests via our CI (Snyk + Semgrep ruleset), full codebase scans weekly. DAST scanning is scheduled against staging every 2 weeks (authenticated scans for sessioned endpoints); targeted ad-hoc DAST runs occur before major releases.
- Patch SLAs (committed): Critical: 48 hours to mitigation and 7 days for validated patch deployment; High: 7 days to mitigation, 30 days to deployment; Medium: 30 days; Low: triaged and batched by quarterly maintenance. We also offer customer-facing accelerations for Dedicated/Private customers under contract.
- Verification workflow: JIRA-based remediation tickets, evidence attachments, and sign-off by Security Engineering. For highest-severity items we provide hotfix backports and a verification pass from our SOC2/pen-test remediation team.

Attachments included: redwood_sbom_20270622.json (CycloneDX), penetration-summary-q1-2027.pdf, vm-sla-commitment-20270622.docx, thirdparty-pen-test-report-202704.pdf (redacted PII).

Evidence store: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-redwood-security-evidence (read-only link provided to your team; we can add additional people on request).

Can we book a 30-minute walkthrough this Thursday 6/24 or Friday 6/25? I propose Thurs 09:00 PT or Fri 11:00 PT.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Solutions — Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Marta Klein <marta.klein@atlasfin.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 07:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: full vulnerability management package + SBOM for procurement RFP

Marta / Vanessa — quick technical clarifications from the infra side.

1) SBOM scope: the attached CycloneDX covers application dependencies, OS packages inside our runtime container images, and 3rd-party model-serving components (inference runtime libs). It does not enumerate ephemeral model weights; we treat weights as data artifacts (separate catalog) — happy to provide a checksum inventory if that helps your intake process.

2) DAST auth coverage: authenticated DAST scans exercise sessioned APIs via a staging service account. We keep a separate token lifecycle per customer when running Dedicated/Private scans to avoid cross-tenant risks.

3) SAST rules: our Semgrep/Snyk rule packs are maintained in a public repo (we can provide read-only access) and are mapped to CWE categories in our vulnerability portal.

If Atlas requires live re-scans on a customer-managed environment (Private deployment), we have a documented runbook and can schedule a fresh DAST + SCA prior to go-live.

- Karthik
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Marta Klein <marta.klein@atlasfin.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: full vulnerability management package + SBOM for procurement RFP

Following up with remediation verification details so Atlas has an audit trail: 

- Critical finding (04/2027): root cause and hotfix committed 04/10; verification by pen-test vendor and our Security Engineering on 04/18. Evidence: JIRA REDW-443 (link in Drive), patch diff + deployment window logs.
- High findings: all fixed by 05/06; verification tickets attached in Drive.
- Pen-test cadence: we run an annual third-party engagement (last: 04/2027) and internal ad-hoc red-team exercises quarterly. Results are summarized in penetration-summary-q1-2027.pdf.

Note: For contractual SLAs we include remediation verification steps and evidence retention retention for 12 months by default; extended retention is available as an add-on.

I can join the walkthrough to run through evidence and the JIRA->CI verification flow.

—Neha Kapoor
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: thirdparty-pen-test-report-202704.pdf)

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the comprehensive package and the SBOM. We reviewed the artifacts with InfoSec. A few asks before we sign off:

1) Can you provide a short SOC 2 report snapshot (redacted) and the location for SOC evidence?
2) We want an inventory checksum for model weights as mentioned (just a digest list) — that will clear a compliance checkbox on our side.
3) Please add our security@atlasfin.com address to the Drive folder so our reviewers can see the raw verification artifacts.

We are good to schedule Friday 11:00 PT for the 30-minute walkthrough. If you can pre-share a 5-slide summary of remediation timelines and SLAs that would help our CTO.

Regards,
Marta Klein
